Note: Hey guys! Back with another SAO doujin. This time, it's the three goddesses of the underworld in reverse bunny outfits! Hope you guys liked it! Working on a few other stuff on the meantime. Hopefully someone scans all the Reze doujins that have come out recently.
On the other hand, I have been thinking of opening commissions/donations as it has been getting a bit hard to do these translations on my own. I avoided it until now since I thought of it as making money off of someone else's work, but I am considering my options now. Never done it before, so would love for some advice! Anyway, sorry for this kind of talk. I hope you loved the work, and hope we meet again, sooner than later!
